Name: Boothill Honkai Star Rail Mod
Author: rumirumm
Description:
[center][b][size=4]﻿Adds the character Boothill from Honkai Star Rail to Stardew Valley!
[/size]
[size=3]Super big thanks to [url=https://forums.nexusmods.com/profile/38070155-ottersqueaks/]ottersqueaks[/url] for helping me reformat and fix bugs regarding the mod! truly a savior![/size][/b][/center][left][b]

[u]PLANS FOR FUTURE UPDATES & FIXES[/u]

- Add his own heart events
- [SVE] Fix his and Clementine's positioning during festivals
- Make Clementine move into the farmhouse after marrying Boothill
- Fix Clementine icon not showing correctly in the NPC map
- Possible dialogue rework/update


[u]_______________________________________________________________________________________________________________________[/u]

[u]UPDATES & FIXES[/u]

[u]7/24/25: [/u]Fixed problem where both Boothill and Clementine won't appear during second year festivals [position fix for SVE still ongoing] Moved their homes to Squeak's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30194]Saloon Second Floor[/url] so they won't intervene with any events in the base Saloon map! It is now required to have the saloon mod first in order for the mod to work ^^

[u]12/16/24[/u]: Added ﻿Internationalization as well as some minor fixes.

[u]12/13/24[/u]: Fixed an issue regarding tokens!

[u]12/12/24: Fixed some dialogue issues
[/u]
_______________________________________________________________________________________________________________________

Please be aware that he is still missing his heart events, and it won't be as immersive as other love interests

[/b][/left]Hello everyone, rumi here! If you guys have been finding me on twitter about the Boothill mod... well, it's finally here!
Do keep in mind that this the very first time I've created a mod, so there are bound to be bugs here and there and not everything is perfect T-T
this is the best version that I've come up with thanks to everyone's suggestions! :D If you ever found any bugs or errors regarding the mod, please make sure to report! And I'll do my best to fix it.

[b][u]This Mod Contains:[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]The character Boothill as his own NPC.
[/list] ﻿This includes his own dialogues and unique sprites.[list]
[*]His daughter that was mentioned in his Character Story as a brand-new NPC!
[/list] ﻿She is named Clementine by default in this mod, something that the community has come up with! I've also added an option to change her name! :D
[list]
[*]Seasonal Outfits and portraits.
[*]Custom toddler sprites.
[*]Toggle to allow Boothill's pregnancy options... (due to popular demand HAHA, can be turned on and off at any time!)
[*]HEART EVENTS are currently disabled due to incompletion (Aside from his introduction event)
[/list][center]

﻿﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/I3xkgJa.png[/img]﻿﻿[/center][center][img]https://i.imgur.com/MBO2V1R.png[/img]
[img]https://imgur.com/ioUcsB6.gif[/img][img]https://imgur.com/3HGC0gH.gif[/img]﻿﻿[/center]﻿

I will do my best to keep the mod up to date and try to make it compatible with other expansion mods! And please, if you guys ever have any suggestions to improve the mod, let me know! 

I'm just a tired art student that jumped into this with little to nothing in hand (my obsession led me to this} So things might be a little slow!
